title: 第325章 剿灭第324章 蟾蜍人
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
蟾蜍人祭司在十几个强壮蟾蜍人的护卫下向后退去，看着这些全身被铁甲包裹的骑士，它那鼓胀的双眼中满是恐惧，只能大声喊道：
“撤退！
向湖边！
进入水中……”
一边喊着，蟾蜍人祭司一边鼓动肥硕的身体，满身脓包破裂开来，形成一片毒雾之墙，将龙血重骑暂时阻挡在身后。
扎木合并没有贪功冒进，虽然刚才杀得痛快，但他还记得自己的任务，现在蟾蜍人们已经被赶过去，任务已经完成，没必要冒险冲进敌人的法术范围，立刻下令道：
“远离那片毒雾，先将这里的敌人清理干净！”
说着，扎木合伸手往挎包里一抓，掏出一柄结实的短弓，连射三箭，将跑得比较慢的几只蟾蜍人射倒在地，龙血重骑们分散开来，将没有跟上大部队的蟾蜍人一一斩杀。
另一边，见重骑兵没有追过来的蟾蜍人祭司松了一口气，但看到身后的族人只剩下50只左右，内心愤怒又无奈：
“伟大的沉眠巨蛙拉曼诺斯啊！
人类如此强大，您卑微的信徒，根本无法战胜他们，又该怎么唤醒您呢？……”
但不管它如何祈祷，它信仰的神祇始终没有回应，仿佛之前告诉它们这个世界即将毁灭，让它们屠杀人类，收集灵魂和血肉的神谕只是幻觉一般。
不过在穿过泥沼后，蟾蜍人祭司已经能闻到一股饱含水汽的清新河风，不管如何，作为部落祭司，它要做的，就是带着族人活下去！
下一秒，脚步仓促的蟾蜍人祭司停下了脚步，原本愤怒的表情也凝固在脸上，只因它已经看到，就在湖边，几排铠甲齐整的高大身影静静伫立，手中还拿着长枪、盾牌、长弓、硬弩等一看就很可怕的武器。
文德尔早已估算好射击距离，当这些蟾蜍人出现时，便已经进入了弓箭和弩箭的射程，立刻下令道：
“弓弩手，射击！”
嘣嘣嘣～咻咻咻——！
严阵以待的弓弩手立刻开始射击，没有护甲保护的蟾蜍人有的当场毙命，有的倒地哀嚎，蟾蜍人祭司见状大喊道：
“给我冲！
杀光这些人类！

为了巨蛙之神！”
“呱！
为了巨蛙之神！”
被激励的蟾蜍人立刻忘却痛苦和恐惧，举着武器向前方的人类军队发起冲锋。
这时，蟾蜍人祭司赶紧带着最忠心的护卫和雌蛙，向着战场侧面发起突围，只要到达水中，部落仍然能够延续！
“吼！”
content_en:
The toad priest retreated under the protection of a dozen strong toad men. Looking at these knights wrapped in iron armor, its bulging eyes were full of fear, and it could only shout loudly:
"Retreat!
Toward the lake!
Into the water…”
While shouting, the toad man priest moved his fat body, and the pustules all over his body burst open, forming a wall of poisonous mist, temporarily blocking the dragon blood heavy knight behind him.
Zhamuhe did not rush ahead because of greed. Although he had just killed happily, he still remembered his mission. Now that the toads had been driven over and the mission was completed, there was no need to risk rushing into the enemy's spell range. He immediately ordered:
"Stay away from that poisonous fog and clean up the enemies here first!"
As he spoke, Zhamuhe reached into his satchel, took out a strong short bow, and shot three arrows in a row, knocking down the slower running toad men to the ground. The dragon-blooded heavy horsemen spread out and killed the toad men who did not keep up with the large army one by one.
On the other side, the toad priest was relieved to see that the heavy cavalry did not pursue him, but when he saw that there were only about 50 tribesmen left behind him, he felt angry and helpless:
"O great sleeping giant frog Lamenos!
Human beings are so powerful that your humble believers cannot defeat them. How can they awaken you? …”
But no matter how it prayed, the gods it believed in never responded, as if the oracle that told them that the world was about to be destroyed and asked them to slaughter humans and collect souls and flesh was just an illusion.
However, after passing through the swamp, the toad priest could smell a fresh river breeze full of water vapor. No matter what, as a tribal priest, what it has to do is to lead the tribe to survive!
The next second, the hurried toad man priest stopped, and the original angry expression froze on his face, because he had already seen, just by the lake, several rows of tall figures with neat armor standing quietly, holding spears, shields, longbows, hard crossbows and other weapons in their hands that looked very scary at first sight.
Wendel had already estimated the shooting distance. When these toad men appeared, they were already within the range of bows and crossbows, and immediately ordered:
"Crossbowman, shoot!"
Boom boom boom~ssssssss—!
The crossbowmen who were waiting in full formation immediately started shooting. Some of the toad men without armor protection were killed on the spot, and some fell to the ground and howled. Upon seeing this, the toad man priest shouted:
“Rush me!
Kill all these humans!
For the giant frog god! "
“Quah!
For the giant frog god! "
The inspired toad men immediately forgot their pain and fear, raised their weapons and charged towards the human army ahead.
At this time, the toad priest quickly took his most loyal guards and female frogs to break out towards the side of the battlefield. As long as they reached the water, the tribe could still continue!
"roar!"
